basics.name: Etienne Cheynet
basics.label: Associate Professor
basics.summary: Associate Professor at the Geophysical Institute, University of Bergen. My research connects atmospheric turbulence, experimental meteorology, offshore wind energy and structural dynamics. This page summarises my academic record; the [complete CV (PDF)](/assets/pdf/CV_Cheynet_2026.pdf) contains the full publication list, supervision, service and outreach.

work.name: University of Bergen
highlights: Research in atmospheric turbulence, remote sensing, wind engineering and offshore wind energy.
PhD and MSc supervision across engineering, geoscience and sustainability.
Course redesign for ENERGI230, ENERGI321 and ENERGI322.

work.name: Dalian University of Technology
work.summary: Joint research, guest teaching, curriculum development and student exchange.

work.name: University of Bergen
highlights: Synchronous long-range lidar observations in the COTUR campaign.
Unfrozen turbulence simulation and analyses of marine and fjord turbulence.

work.name: University of Stavanger
highlights: Marine boundary-layer turbulence, Doppler lidar measurements and wind flow in complex terrain.
Full-scale structural dynamics and wind-induced response of bridges.
